text: To facilitate a land exchange between the applicant and the City, it would be helpful if a demolition approval for the above-noted properties is approved as soon as possible. My office has been advised that the staff report will not be ready in time for this meeting of NYCC. I am recommending that North York Community Council direct the Chief Building Official to report directly to Council on this matter

City Council on May 11 and 12, 2022, adopted the following: 1.
